name: 18940 · Newtown, PA
findings: ZIP 18940 (Newtown) has 207 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18940 (Newtown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18940 (Newtown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
